title: GPU & NVIDIA: Zero to Hero for AI Engineering
summary: From bare-metal GPU discovery through driver install, CUDA, thermal tuning, and multi-GPU training clusters.
sections: Modern deep learning is matrix math at scale. CPUs handle control flow; GPUs provide thousands of cores for parallel tensor operations. Before writing PyTorch code, you must know how to discover GPUs, install the correct driver, verify CUDA, and read thermal/power limits.
On Linux use lspci and nvidia-smi. In FixitLab GPU labs the simulator exposes the same outputs. A missing device usually means driver not loaded or GPU in persistence-off state.

lspci | grep -i nvidia
nvidia-smi
nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,POWER
Check temperature before long training jobs.
Match driver branch to CUDA toolkit required by your framework. Wrong kernel module version causes NVRM errors. Always blacklist nouveau on RHEL/CentOS before installing NVIDIA.

dnf install kernel-devel-$(uname -r)
# blacklist nouveau in /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-nouveau.conf
dracut --force
Data-center GPUs throttle above ~83°C. Use nvidia-smi dmon or DCGM in production. Fix airflow, replace thermal paste on legacy nodes, or cap power with nvidia-smi -pl.
Thermal shutdown protects silicon — treat alerts seriously.
AMD MI-series uses ROCm instead of CUDA. rocminfo lists agents; HIP is the CUDA-like API. Mixed clusters need separate node pools per vendor.
Use NCCL for distributed training. MIG partitions A100/H100 for inference tenants. Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES per job.

title: Bare Metal, IPMI & MAAS: Zero to Hero
summary: Commission machines with MAAS, manage BMC/IPMI power, PXE boot, RAID, and hand off to Kubernetes.
sections: VMs share a hypervisor; bare metal gives full hardware for latency-sensitive AI and storage workloads. You own firmware, RAID, NIC firmware, and BMC.
The BMC is an out-of-band management controller. ipmitool talks to it for power, sensors, and SOL console even when the OS is down.
ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc.example -U admin -P pass power status
MAAS: enlist → commission (hardware tests) → deploy (curtin/cloud-init). Failed commissioning often means bad DNS, blocked PXE, or missing drivers.

maas machines list
maas machine commission <id>
Use MAAS simulator in FixitLab baremetal labs.
PXE needs DHCP option 66/67 or iPXE chain. VLAN tags on trunk ports must match MAAS fabric settings.
After OS deploy, use LXD for system containers or KVM for full VMs on the same node. virsh list shows KVM guests; lxc list shows LXD.
Cross-tech labs chain MAAS deploy → KVM → monitoring.
VyOS provides router/firewall/VPN on bare metal edges. Configure interfaces, OSPF, and BGP before multi-rack AI clusters.
